repos_data.description: Tailwind CSS palettes (50–950) from any color, for Tailwind v4, v3, v2 and v1. A VS Code extension, a CLI, and an MCP server for AI agents.

Mechanically validated frontend aesthetics for AI agents: 89-palette evidence library, OKLCH generation, WCAG/APCA contrast, color-blind-safe data colors, AI-slop detection, theme packs, W3C design tokens. Skill + MCP server.
